sets.setName: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

bonuses.effect: After a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Skill, or Burst hits, ATK increases by 25% for 6s. With Witch's Homework completed, CRIT Rate also increases by 20%.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes a hit triggered the upgraded Resolve of Pastoral Winds effect and Witch's Homework is complete.

bonuses.effect: Max HP +1,000.
Opening a chest regenerates 30% Max HP over 5s.
bonuses.assumption: The healing effect is noted but is not a persistent optimizer stat.

bonuses.effect: Geo DMG Bonus +15%.
Collecting a Crystallize shard or triggering Lunar-Crystallize gives the party a 35% DMG Bonus for the corresponding element for 10s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the shard for the optimized damage element was collected and the 10s effect is active.

bonuses.effect: Elemental Mastery +80.
While off-field, Lunar Reaction DMG increases by 20%, plus another 40% at Ascendant Gleam.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the wearer is off-field and the party's Moonsign is Ascendant Gleam.

bonuses.effect: CRIT Rate +12%.
CRIT Rate increases by another 24% while HP is below 70%.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the wearer is below 70% HP.

bonuses.effect: Cryo DMG Bonus +15%.
CRIT Rate increases by 20% against Cryo-affected opponents and by another 20% when they are Frozen.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the opponent is Frozen.

bonuses.effect: Physical DMG Bonus +25%.
After defeating an opponent, Charged Attack DMG increases by 50% and its Stamina cost becomes 0 for 10s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes an opponent was defeated within the last 10s.

bonuses.effect: DMG increases by 30% against opponents above 50% HP.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the opponent is above 50% HP.

bonuses.effect: Energy Recharge +20%.
After using a Skill, grants nearby party members a 20% matching Elemental DMG Bonus, upgraded to 40% by Witch's Homework and Hexerei: Secret Rite.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the Skill-triggered Mortal Hymn upgrade is active; same-element bonuses do not stack.

bonuses.effect: Pyro DMG Bonus +15%.
Overloaded, Burning, and Burgeon DMG +40%; Vaporize and Melt DMG +15%. Skill use boosts the 2-piece Pyro bonus by 50% per stack, up to 3 stacks.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes all 3 Skill stacks are active.

bonuses.effect: Dendro DMG Bonus +15%.
Skill or Burst hits reduce the target's Dendro RES by 30% for 8s, including when triggered off-field.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the target was hit and the resistance reduction is active.

bonuses.effect: For every different element in the party, the wearer gains 30% RES to that element.
bonuses.assumption: Shows the 30% resistance granted for each represented element; party composition determines which elements receive it.

bonuses.effect: Anemo DMG Bonus +15%.
After a Charged Attack hits, Normal Attack SPD +10% and Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG +40% for 15s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes a Charged Attack hit within the last 15s.

bonuses.effect: Superconduct DMG +80% and Stellar-Conduct DMG +40%. Attacks against affected opponents gain 16% CRIT Rate.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the opponent is affected by Superconduct or Stellar-Conduct.

bonuses.effect: Normal Attack hits can trigger Valley Rite, adding damage equal to 70% of ATK; failed triggers increase the next trigger chance.
bonuses.assumption: Valley Rite is treated as active, but its ATK-scaled proc is not represented as a persistent stat.

bonuses.effect: Energy Recharge +20%.
Burst DMG increases by 25% of Energy Recharge, up to 75%.
bonuses.assumption: Uses the maximum 75% bonus; reaching it requires 300% Energy Recharge.

bonuses.effect: Cryo DMG Bonus +15%.
At 0 Energy, Normal Attack DMG and Burst DMG each gain 60%, but dealing one type disables the other bonus for 6s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes 0 Energy. Both potential bonuses are shown, though their post-hit windows are mutually exclusive.

bonuses.effect: Elemental Mastery +80.
Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG +40%, and Lunar-Bloom DMG +10%; triggering those reactions can double these bonuses at 4 stacks.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes all 4 reaction-triggered stacks are active.

bonuses.effect: When Bond of Life changes, DMG increases by 18% for 6s, up to 3 stacks.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes all 3 Bond of Life stacks are active.

bonuses.effect: Skill DMG +20%.
Defeating an opponent resets Skill cooldown, once every 15s.
bonuses.assumption: The cooldown reset is noted but is not a persistent optimizer stat.

bonuses.effect: Elemental Mastery +80.
After a reaction, each same-element ally grants 14% ATK and each different-element ally grants 50 Elemental Mastery for 8s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes three different-element allies, giving the reaction-focused maximum of 150 Elemental Mastery.

bonuses.effect: Normal Attack DMG +35% for Sword, Claymore, or Polearm users.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the wearer uses a Sword, Claymore, or Polearm.

bonuses.effect: Skill DMG +20%.
Skill DMG +25%, with another +25% while off-field.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the wearer is off-field.

bonuses.effect: Hydro DMG Bonus +15%.
After using a Skill, Normal and Charged Attack DMG +30% for 15s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes a Skill was used within the last 15s.

bonuses.effect: Geo hits on-field or time off-field build up to 4 Curiosity stacks; each grants 6% DEF and 6% Geo DMG.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes all 4 Curiosity stacks are active.

bonuses.effect: Elemental Mastery +80.
Triggering a reaction grants all party members 120 Elemental Mastery for 8s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes a reaction was triggered within the last 8s.

bonuses.effect: Pyro RES +40%.
DMG +35% against opponents affected by Pyro.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the opponent is affected by Pyro.

bonuses.effect: Plunging Attack DMG +25%.
Plunging, Charged, and Skill hits build up to 5 Radiance Everlasting stacks; each grants 15% Plunging Attack DMG for 6s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes all 5 Radiance Everlasting stacks are active.

bonuses.effect: Picking up Mora restores 300 HP.
bonuses.assumption: The pickup healing is noted but is not a persistent optimizer stat.

bonuses.effect: Healing Bonus +15%.
Using a Skill or Burst increases healing received by the party by 20% for 10s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes a Skill or Burst was used within the last 10s.

bonuses.effect: Normal and Charged Attack DMG +15%.
When HP changes, CRIT Rate +12% for 5s, up to 3 stacks.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes all 3 HP-change stacks are active.

bonuses.effect: Normal and Charged Attack DMG +15%.
After using a Skill, Normal and Charged Attack DMG +25% for 8s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes a Skill was used within the last 8s.

bonuses.effect: Elemental Mastery +80.
Nearby Lunar Reactions grant 15%/30% CRIT Rate at Nascent/Ascendant Gleam. Each different Gleaming Moon effect in the party adds 10% Lunar Reaction DMG.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes Ascendant Gleam and both currently available Gleaming Moon effects in the party.

sets.setName: Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods

bonuses.effect: After using a Skill, Geo DMG +20% for 10s; a Crystallize shield or nearby Lunar-Crystallize Moondrifts increase that effect by 150%.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the Skill effect and the Crystallize/Lunar-Crystallize upgrade are active.

bonuses.effect: Burst DMG +20%.
Using a Burst grants the party 20% ATK for 12s; this does not stack.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes a Burst was used within the last 12s.

bonuses.effect: Hydro DMG Bonus +15%.
Different attack types build Mirrored Nymph stacks; at 3 stacks ATK +25% and Hydro DMG +15% for 8s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes 3 or more Mirrored Nymph stacks are active.

bonuses.effect: While on-field in Nightsoul's Blessing, DMG +15%.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the wearer is on-field in Nightsoul's Blessing.

bonuses.effect: Consuming a Nightsoul point on-field grants 40% CRIT Rate for 6s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes a Nightsoul point was consumed within the last 6s.

bonuses.effect: Healing Bonus +15%.
Healing creates a Sea-Dyed Foam that records up to 30,000 healing and deals damage based on 90% of the recorded amount.
bonuses.assumption: The healing-triggered damage proc is noted but is not a persistent optimizer stat.

bonuses.effect: Physical DMG Bonus +25%.
Skill hits grant 9% ATK for 7s, up to 2 stacks; at 2 stacks the 2-piece Physical bonus is doubled.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes both Skill-hit stacks are active.

bonuses.effect: Hydro affects the wearer for 40% less time.
Pyro affects the wearer for 40% less time.
Electro affects the wearer for 40% less time.
Cryo affects the wearer for 40% less time.
Charged Attack CRIT Rate +30%.
Shield Strength +35%.
While protected by a shield, Normal and Charged Attack DMG +40%.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the wearer is protected by a shield.

bonuses.effect: Energy Recharge +20%.
Collecting particles or orbs gives 3 Energy to Bow and Catalyst party members, once every 3s.
bonuses.assumption: The periodic party Energy gain is noted but is not a persistent optimizer stat.

sets.setName: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

bonuses.effect: A nearby party member's Nightsoul Burst restores 6 Energy to the wearer.
bonuses.assumption: The triggered Energy restoration is noted but is not a persistent Energy Recharge stat.

bonuses.effect: Triggering a related reaction grants the party 12% Elemental DMG for the involved elements, plus 28% when triggered in Nightsoul's Blessing.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the reaction was triggered during Nightsoul's Blessing and the 40% total bonus is active.

bonuses.effect: Using a Skill at 15 or more Energy consumes 15 Energy and grants 50% Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG for 10s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the wearer had enough Energy and paid the 15-Energy cost within the last 10s.

bonuses.effect: Energy Recharge +20%.
Dealing Elemental DMG grants the party 60/120 Elemental Mastery at Nascent/Ascendant Gleam. Each different Gleaming Moon effect adds 10% Lunar Reaction DMG.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes Ascendant Gleam and both currently available Gleaming Moon effects in the party.

bonuses.effect: Healing Bonus +15%.
Healing records up to 15,000 HP, then empowers 5 attacks by 8% of the recorded healing.
bonuses.assumption: The healing-scaled attack proc is noted but is not a persistent optimizer stat.

bonuses.effect: Skill hits grant nearby party members 20% ATK and 30% Shield Strength for 3s, including from off-field.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes a Skill hit occurred within the last 3s.

bonuses.effect: Energy Recharge +20%.
Using a Burst restores 2 Energy to other party members every 2s for 6s.
bonuses.assumption: The party Energy restoration is noted but is not a persistent Energy Recharge stat.

bonuses.effect: Electro DMG Bonus +15%.
Overloaded, Electro-Charged, Superconduct, and Hyperbloom DMG +40%; Aggravate +20%; Lunar-Charged and Stellar-Conduct +20%. Relevant reactions also reduce Skill cooldown.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the relevant reaction bonus is active; cooldown reduction is not a persistent stat.

bonuses.effect: Electro RES +40%.
DMG +35% against opponents affected by Electro.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the opponent is affected by Electro.

bonuses.effect: All Elemental RES +20%.
Taking elemental damage grants another 30% RES to that element for 10s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes matching elemental damage was taken within the last 10s.

bonuses.effect: Incoming Healing +20%.
Using a Burst restores 20% HP.
bonuses.assumption: The one-time Burst healing is noted but is not a persistent optimizer stat.

bonuses.effect: DMG increases up to 50%; in combat it rises near Burning opponents and falls when none are nearby.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the maximum 50% effect is active with a Burning opponent nearby.

bonuses.effect: Using a Burst grants 8% ATK for 16s; HP losses grant another 10% ATK up to 4 times.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the Burst effect and all 4 HP-loss stacks are active while the wearer remains on-field.

bonuses.effect: Anemo DMG Bonus +15%.
Swirl DMG +60% and the target's RES to the Swirled element is reduced by 40% for 10s.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the target was Swirled with the optimized element within the last 10s.

bonuses.effect: Skill and Burst DMG +10%; taking damage increases that effect by 80% per stack, up to 5 stacks.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes all 5 damage-taken stacks are active.

bonuses.effect: Elemental Mastery +80.
Charged Attack DMG +35% for Catalyst or Bow users.
bonuses.assumption: Assumes the wearer uses a Catalyst or Bow.
